mapping.method: exact Float32 rest coordinate + named object + anatomical region; duplicates require exact unchanged local topology, tags and mass

limitations: Counterfactual is kinematic strain only, not material energy or force.
Endpoint-field differences include model-induced trajectories and solver effects; this diagnostic alone does not distinguish them.
A small relative counterfactual discrepancy is not native mesh admission.

solver_control_comparison.qualification: Matched runtime and numerical controls. Existing captured-force and regional-strain engineering screen; no material-energy or sustained-motion qualification.
